thread.title: Why the Down Move in Stocks Is Healthy

author: Home
title: Why the Down Move in Stocks Is Healthy
text:
Thursday's notable down move in the U.S. stock market may have been very healthy for the market. It was a response to expected inflation, which could cool consumer demand across sectors.
If investors are seemingly level headed - at least in my eyes - they'll be more prone to responding to changes in the economy. So instead of having abrupt corrections or pullbacks when the market has gotten too hot, we might see more incremental movements.
Aside from the broader market, Snap ( SNAP ) , which sold off Thursday, is up almost 3% in pre-market trading Friday. Also, Amazon ( AMZN ) and Apple ( AAPL ) were infiltrated with a chip by Chinese hackers, something TheStreet will have coverage on.
Also, Cotsco ( COST ) is our stock of the day. Costco had earnings Thursday. After falling post-earnings, it's now down even more in pre-market trading Friday.
